summary: Sentence-BERT (SBERT) modifies the BERT architecture using siamese and triplet networks to generate semantically meaningful sentence embeddings. It enables efficient comparison via cosine-similarity, drastically reducing computational overhead for tasks like clustering and semantic search from hours to seconds. SBERT outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods on Semantic Textual Similarity (STS) benchmarks and transfer learning tasks.
keywords: Sentence-BERT, Siamese Networks, Sentence Embeddings, Semantic Textual Similarity, NLP
topics: Natural Language Processing, Machine Learning, Information Retrieval
